head: 9007cee1
note: Pseudo-code written by the reviewing agent; explain_check.py verifies every step against the cited lines.

cards.title: Opted-out type: a field with no key still gets a warning

steps.text: a class `Foo` with `SuppressSourceGeneration = true`.
it has a public property `Member` with no key.
the analyzer runs on it through `VerifyCS.Test`.
exactly one `MsgPack004` is reported, on `Member`; anything else fails.

does_not_check: It checks the diagnostic's id and position, not its message.
It does not check that the type still serializes at run time.
notes: It also passes before the change, so it guards old behaviour, not the fix.

cards.title: Opted-out type: a private field still gets a warning

steps.text: a class `Foo` with `SuppressSourceGeneration = true`, not allowing private members.
it has a private field `member` with `[Key(0)]`.
the analyzer runs on it through `VerifyCS.Test`.
exactly one `MsgPack015` is reported, on the attribute; anything else fails.

does_not_check: It checks the diagnostic's id and position, not its message.
It does not check the code fix the diagnostic offers.
notes: It also passes before the change, so it guards old behaviour, not the fix.

cards.title: Opted-out type: a field whose type is not set up for saving still gets a warning

steps.text: a plain class `Other` with no MessagePack attribute.
a class `Foo` with `SuppressSourceGeneration = true` has a property `Member` of type `Other`.
the analyzer runs on it through `VerifyCS.Test`.
exactly one `MsgPack003` is reported, on `Member`; anything else fails.

does_not_check: It checks the diagnostic's id and position, not its message.
It does not try a bad member type with a duplicate or mixed key, where the change drops this diagnostic.
notes: It also passes before the change, so it guards old behaviour, not the fix.

cards.title: Opted-out type: two fields with the same number key get a warning, no crash

steps.text: a class `Foo` with `SuppressSourceGeneration = true`.
two properties, `Member1` and `Member2`, both use `[Key(0)]`.
the analyzer runs on it through `VerifyCS.Test`.
exactly one `MsgPack005` is reported, on `Member2`; a crash report would fail it.

does_not_check: It checks the diagnostic's id and position, not that the message says 'must be unique'.
It does not try `[Key(null)]`, which still crashes the analyzer after the change.
notes: It fails before the change, when the analyzer also crashed, and passes after.

cards.title: Opted-out type: two fields with the same text key get a warning, no crash

steps.text: a class `Foo` with `SuppressSourceGeneration = true`.
two properties, `Member1` and `Member2`, both use the same string key "a".
the analyzer runs on it through `VerifyCS.Test`.
exactly one `MsgPack005` is reported, on `Member2`; a crash report would fail it.

does_not_check: It checks the diagnostic's id and position, not that the message says 'must be unique'.
It uses only properties, not fields, though the fix was also copied into the fields loop.
notes: It fails before the change, when the analyzer also crashed, and passes after.

cards.title: Opted-out type: mixing number and text keys gets a warning, no crash

steps.text: a class `Foo` with `SuppressSourceGeneration = true`.
`Member1` uses a number key, `[Key(0)]`, and `Member2` uses a string key.
the analyzer runs on it through `VerifyCS.Test`.
exactly one `MsgPack005` is reported, on `Member2`; a crash report would fail it.

does_not_check: 'Must be unique' and 'must be of the same type' share this id, and it does not check which message appears.
It does not try a string key first, or a member whose type is also unserializable.
notes: It fails before the change, when the analyzer also crashed, and passes after.

cards.title: Normal type: two fields with the same key get a warning, no crash

steps.text: a class `Foo` with plain `[MessagePackObject]`, so generation is not suppressed.
two properties, `Member1` and `Member2`, both use `[Key(0)]`.
the analyzer runs on it through `VerifyCS.Test`.
exactly one `MsgPack005` is reported, on `Member2`; a crash report would fail it.

does_not_check: It checks the diagnostic's id and position, not its message.
It runs only the analyzer, so it does not check what the generator emits.
notes: It fails before the change, when the analyzer also crashed, and passes after.

cards.title: Opted-out type: warnings about generated code stay quiet

steps.text: per the test comment, `MsgPack011`, `MsgPack016` and `MsgPack017` matter only for generated formatters.
a non-partial class `Foo` sets `AllowPrivate = true, SuppressSourceGeneration = true`.
it has a private field `member`, an init-only `Prop1` with a default, and `Prop2`.
the analyzer runs through `VerifyCS.Test` with no expected diagnostics marked.
`RunAsync()` passes only if no diagnostic at all is reported.

does_not_check: It has no control case showing these diagnostics appear without `SuppressSourceGeneration`.
It does not say which member should trigger which skipped diagnostic.
notes: It also passes before the change, so it guards old behaviour, not the fix.

cards.title: Opted-out type: no generated code is produced for it

steps.text: a type `SuppressedSourceGenerationType` sets `SuppressSourceGeneration = true` and keys `Id` and `Name`.
the test asks `GeneratedMessagePackResolver.Instance` for that type's formatter.
the answer must be null (`Assert.Null`).

does_not_check: It only asks the resolver at run time; it does not inspect generated files.
It does not check that the analyzer still validates the type.
notes: Passes before and after the change (SDK 9.0.321), so it guards this behaviour but does not show the fix.

cards.title: Opted-out type: it can still be saved and loaded

steps.text: a type `SuppressedSourceGenerationType` sets `SuppressSourceGeneration = true` and keys `Id` and `Name`.
a value with `Id = 7` and `Name = "seven"`.
it is serialized and deserialized with `MessagePackSerializerOptions.Standard`.
`result.Id` must be 7 and `result.Name` must be "seven".

does_not_check: Despite its name, it does not check which resolver handled the type.
It checks that the value survives the round trip, not the bytes.
notes: Passes before and after the change (SDK 9.0.321), so it guards this behaviour but does not show the fix.
